241        public static CGMAlert fromId(int id) {
242            for (CGMAlert alert : values()) {
243                if (alert.id() == id) {

246            }
247            return null;

250        public static Set<CGMAlert> fromBitmask(BigInteger bitmask) {
251            Set<CGMAlert> set = new TreeSet<>();
252            for (CGMAlert a : values()) {
253                if (bitmask.testBit(a.id())) {
254                    set.add(a);
255                }
256            }
257            return set;
258        }
259
260        public static BigInteger toBitmask(CGMAlert ...alerts) {
261            BigInteger i = BigInteger.ZERO;
262            for (CGMAlert a : alerts) {
263                i.setBit(a.id());
264            }
265            return i;
266        }
